blocks.text: KING OF JUDAH · TWO KINGDOMS
Uzziah. Fifty-two years in Jerusalem, the last of them as a leper.
REIGNEDi
52 years c. 791–739 BC (dates vary)
CAPITAL
Jerusalem
HOUSE
House of David 10th of 20 in Judah
VERDICT
✓ Did right “And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done”
PROPHETS
Zechariah · Isaiah son of Amoz · Amos · Hosea
JUDAH (THE SOUTH): 20 RULERS REHOBOAM → ZEDEKIAH
ACCESSION
How Uzziah came to power
"All the people of Judah" made him king at sixteen in place of his father Amaziah. 2 Kings 14:21 2 Chronicles 26:1
SUCCESSION
The two kingdoms
THE VERDICT
How Scripture judges the reign
“And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done”
2 Kings 15:3 (KJV) →
BUT ALSO
But also: "the high places were not removed". 2 Kings 15:4
Chronicles: "as long as he sought the LORD, God made him to prosper" — then "his heart was lifted up to his destruction". 2 Chronicles 26:5 2 Chronicles 26:16
CHRONICLES GIVES IT AS
“And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.”
2 Chronicles 26:4 (KJV) →
JUDAH (THE SOUTH): 20 RULERS
✓ Did right ✕ Did evil ◐ Mixed ● No verdict formula
THE KINGDOM
Jerusalem and the places of the reign
Judah (the south) · tribe of Judah. Only places Scripture names are shown, each where the Atlas puts it.
EVENTS
Wars, works and turning points
UNDATED IN SCRIPTURE
THE NATION
What the nation did
The people still sacrificed on the high places. 2 Kings 15:4
PROPHETS
Prophets of the reign
Ze Zechariah Uzziah sought God in his days; Chronicles says he "had understanding in the visions of God".
Is Isaiah son of Amoz “In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up”
Am Amos A herdsman of Tekoa who prophesied concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah and Jeroboam.
Ho Hosea His word came in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah.
ON THE WORLD STAGE
The powers of the day
ISRAEL
Jeroboam II · Zachariah · Shallum · Menahem · Pekahiah · Pekah
OUTSIDE THE BIBLE
OUTSIDE THE BIBLE · ABOUT 738 BC
"Azriau" in Tiglath-pileser III's annals
OUTSIDE THE BIBLE · 1ST CENTURY BC – 1ST CENTURY AD
Uzziah's burial plaque
TWO ACCOUNTS
Where Kings and Chronicles differ
Each ribbon joins the two accounts of one matter, passage to passage.
His name
2 KINGS
2 CHRONICLES
Why he became a leper
2 KINGS
2 CHRONICLES
His burial
2 KINGS
2 CHRONICLES
Only in Chronicles
2 KINGS
2 CHRONICLES
DATES DIFFER
When was it?
SCRIPTURE'S NUMBERS
No years given
52 years (2 Kgs 15:2). Scripture gives lengths and cross-dates, never BC years.
THIELE, REVISED BY MCFALL (1991)
Shared rule with Amaziah, 791–767 BC
Printed form: 767–739; co-regency from 791 (PDF p. 24, 26).
YOUNG (2005), REVISING THIELE
Shared rule with Amaziah, 791–767 BC
Printed form: 767–740/739; co-regency from 791/790 (p. 246 (Table 2)).
ALBRIGHT (1945)
Printed form: c. 783–742 (p. 21).
TRADITIONAL DATES (USSHER, 1658)
Printed form: 810–758 (p. 53 (scan leaf n31)).
Counted from a co-regency with Amaziah
L. McFall (1991); R. C. Young (2005)
Azariah was made co-regent in September 791 (Young: 791/790), in Amaziah's sixth year; his fifty-two years run from then to 739. 2 Kings 15:1–2 2 Kings 14:21 [117][130]
No co-regency
W. F. Albright (1945)
Albright gave Uzziah about 783–742 BC and shortened the reign to 42 years against the Hebrew text's 52. 2 Kings 15:2 [161]
IN SCRIPTURE
Every passage
CHAPTERS · 8
2 Kings 14 2 Kings 15 2 Chronicles 26 Isaiah 1 Isaiah 6 Hosea 1 Amos 1 Zechariah 14
PASSAGES · 12
2 Kings 14:21–22 2 Kings 15:1–8 2 Kings 15:13 2 Kings 15:17 2 Kings 15:23 2 Kings 15:27 2 Chronicles 26:1–23 Isaiah 1:1 Isaiah 6:1 Hosea 1:1 Amos 1:1 Zechariah 14:5
WHAT SCRIPTURE DOES NOT SAY
Kings does not say why the LORD struck him with leprosy.
Scripture does not date the earthquake within his reign.
Scripture does not say in which year of his reign the leprosy began.
IDENTIFICATIONS THIS PAGE RELIES ON

From the textKings mostly calls him Azariah, but uses Uzziah too (2 Kgs 15:13, 32); Chronicles, Isaiah, Hosea, Amos and Zechariah call him Uzziah. The site keeps both names on one person record. 2 Kings 15:1 2 Kings 15:13 2 Kings 15:32 2 Chronicles 26:1 Isaiah 6:1
